@needs_git
    def test_reverted_untracked_history_path_does_not_break_diff_or_finalize(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        temp = workspace / "temporary.txt"
        temp.write_text("temporary\n", encoding="utf-8")
        temp.unlink()

        ok, output = check_workspace_diff(workspace, ["temporary.txt"])
        self.assertTrue(ok, output)

        result = finalize_git(
            workspace,
            "ai/test",
            "should not commit",
            False,
            logger,
            ["temporary.txt"],
        )
        self.assertFalse(result["committed"])
